decisions.title: Goal Tracking OS is non-LLM-first
decisions.decision: Goal, evidence, task, blocker, and decision state must be stored in structured local records before LLM assistance is treated as useful.
decisions.consequence: LLM summaries can assist, but local records and validators remain the source of truth.

decisions.title: Do not resolve tracked deletions implicitly
decisions.decision: Tracked deletions must be reviewed and resolved in a focused repository hygiene PR rather than silently restored, staged, or committed.
decisions.consequence: Foundation remains blocked until explicit restore, replace, archive, or approved deletion decisions are made.

decisions.title: Repository intelligence should be read-only first
decisions.decision: Repository intelligence should emit findings and evidence before it performs cleanup, mutation, or external calls.
decisions.consequence: Initial scanner work should create local records, not modify repository state.

decisions.title: Review cadence records must be real
decisions.decision: Weekly and monthly review records must only be created when those reviews are actually performed with current evidence.
decisions.consequence: The 2026-W25 weekly review and 2026-06 monthly review are recorded from current evidence; templates remain templates until each real cadence event occurs.
